items.title: A 67-Year-Old With $750,000 in Pfizer, Enterprise Products and UPS Collects $3,765 a Month in Dividends. How Safe Is Each Check?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysAt today’s prices, a hypothetical $750,000 portfolio split evenly across Pfizer, Enterprise Products Partners and UPS pays about $45,200 a year in dividends, or about $3,760 a month. Enterprise Products Partners’ distribution looks the safest of the three, covered 1.

items.title: A 66-Year-Old Swapped QYLD for JEPQ in a $1.27 Million Portfolio. Here’s What Happened to His $8,467 Monthly Paycheck
items.summary: One retiree dumped a famous 12% yield fund for a rival that pays nearly the same, and the real difference has nothing to do with this month's check. The gap shows up years later, when inflation starts taking its cut.
